ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with approximately 55% high-intensity (white/off-white) and 45% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe (viewer perspective) displays a central high-intensity white region heavily overlaid with low-intensity vertical streaks and mottling. Right lobe shows a more contiguous white blob bounded by a thick dark trailing edge and a dark central trunk originating at the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree angle; depth extends approximately 15% into the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) observed along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased pixel-amplitude and jaggedness on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge curvature transitioning to a sharp upward taper at the distal tips; trailing edge exhibits a concave sweep toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of small, circular dark pixel groups distributed sparsely across the mid-section of the right lobe's white pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, unaligned dark linear disruption (diagonal) on the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe, and multiple vertical parallel linear streaks on the left lobe's white surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Brown-colored, textured irregular mass attached to the extreme distal tip of the right lobe, contrasting with the black/white fluke pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dendritic or ink-blot pigmentation pattern originating from the peduncle/median notch area and branching into the white regions of both lobes.
